# The Sheema Edit

Official website: https://thesheemaedit.com/
Creator: Rasheema Abdullah
Known as: Sheema

The Sheema Edit is an independent personal blog created by Rasheema Abdullah, also known as Sheema. It covers mental wellness, unmasking, motherhood, chronic illness, lifestyle, beauty, and funny real life stories.
